title: Managed Database: setup fee
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database setup fee is specified by contracted tier. One-time fee for a newly activated holding; USD decimal. Fee for terminating an on-demand holding, excluding accrued usage and commitment liability; USD decimal. Fee for restoring a suspended holding; USD decimal. Fee per bank-confirmed returned remittance; USD decimal.

| Contracted tier | Setup fee | Termination fee | Resumption fee | Failed payment fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 |

## Tier comparison
For setup fee, Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore and Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore use the same declared value of 0.0.
